title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 11: Mayumi Hirose
native_title: プラドル・ディスク Ｖｏｌ．１１ ～廣瀬真弓～
overview:
A 16-year-old with a promising future! '97 Miss Young Magazine Mayumi Hirose!!

Volume 11 of the Private Idol Disc series is a photo collection and quiz disc starring Mayumi Hirose, with photography by Kazuo Ito. Browse her photo album, learn more about her through an interview of 100 questions, and play mini games including a "look this way" game and a quiz.

- Photo Hall: photo album
- 100 Questions: Q&A interview
- Game Hall: "look this way" and a quiz
- Production credits

これからが期待の16歳!97ミスヤングマガジン廣瀬真弓!!
